items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And Sam Woodyard come in there to play drums, and Sam had every record that the band made.

ctx.x: And Sam Woodyard come in there to play drums, and Sam had every record that the band made. He didn't even have to think about playing the music. Now, we had the drum number in the book, 'Skin Deep,' that Louie Bellson wrote, and Duke asked Sam, he said, 'Woodyard,' he said, 'can you play 'Skin Deep?' He said, 'Why, sure,' and we went and lit into 'Skin Deep,' and breaks and everything, solo and everything, he ain't missed nothing.
